answer: After the tuning the drumplayer settles at the drumworks, laces the shell on the way and pegs the hoop while the skins settle. The inlet ties the cord, the atlas stamps the shell, the spiral heads the drum. The circle refuses a dead hoop unless 69389 damp hoops and 69389 damp skins stand behind it.
